dialogues.speaker: Yaguzhinsky
dialogues.text: Photography is allowed, but please keep your distance if you wish to take group photos.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do lots of people come here to do that? Take photos, I mean.

dialogues.speaker: Yaguzhinsky
dialogues.text: Yes. Don't ask me why, but this is quickly becoming a must-see site for visitors to Snezhnograd.

dialogues.speaker: Yaguzhinsky
dialogues.text: Some tourists even request that I strike up designated poses, all the better for them to take pictures with me.

dialogues.speaker: Yaguzhinsky
dialogues.text: It's probably only a matter of time before I find myself featured in a travel brochure... What a headache.

dialogues.speaker: Yaguzhinsky
dialogues.text: So you're not here to take a photo, then? In that case, please keep your distance.

dialogues.speaker: Yaguzhinsky
dialogues.text: Um... I'm sorry, but I'm standing guard here, and cannot provide the service you request.

dialogues.speaker: Yaguzhinsky
dialogues.text: Also, how many times do I have to say this? This is an important military installation, not a tourist attraction!

dialogues.speaker: Yaguzhinsky
dialogues.text: Alright. In that case, please keep your distance.
